bio: Welcome, Class of 2029! I was raised in Massachusetts before moving to Maine for college. I received my BA in history from Bates College where I met my wife, Flora. Currently, I am pursuing a PhD in English literature from Boston College. Flora and I love trying new recipes, watching old movies, and exploring New England. We look forward to meeting you!
